# Juli Ramon

> Front-end developer and team lead based in Barcelona. Builds websites and e-commerce, leads the front-end team at LA TEVA WEB, and works day to day with Claude Code and Cursor, orchestrating AI agents and reviewing every diff.

This is the personal site and portfolio of Juli Ramon. The site is a single page; each section below is available as an anchor on https://juliramon.dev.

## About

- Role: Front-End Team Lead at [LA TEVA WEB](https://latevaweb.com), recognised as the second-best SEO agency in Spain, building websites and e-commerce for clients.
- Location: Barcelona, Spain.
- Focus: websites and online stores, front-end team leadership (code review, shared standards, mentoring, planning), web performance (Core Web Vitals) and UI craft from Figma to production.
- Motto: "Do what you love and do it always."

## Skills and tools

- Front-end: React, Next.js, JavaScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Sass
- E-commerce and CMS: Shopify, WordPress
- Back-end: PHP, MySQL, Node.js
- Other: Git, Figma
- AI workflow: Claude Code (main tool, used to orchestrate agents on multi-step tasks) and Cursor (editor). Every AI-generated diff is reviewed by a human.

## Experience

- [LA TEVA WEB](https://latevaweb.com) — Front-End Team Lead (present). Leads the front-end team building websites and e-commerce for clients, from Shopify and WordPress to custom React and Next.js builds; brought Claude Code and Cursor into the team's daily workflow.
- [Escapadesenparella.cat](https://escapadesenparella.cat) — Founder & developer (side project). A guide to getaways for couples in Catalonia that has been featured on TV. Built with Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Stripe and Google Maps.

- [Favicon Generator](https://juliramon.dev/projects/favicon-generator): side project. Turns one image into every favicon size, a multi-size .ico, the HTML tags and a web manifest, in a zip. Built with React, Tailwind CSS, the Canvas API and JSZip.
- [Trazo · SVG animator](https://juliramon.dev/projects/svg-animated): side project. Turns a static icon into a self-contained animated SVG with embedded CSS. Built with HTML, CSS animations, JavaScript and SVG.
